transcript.text: Good afternoon, everyone. We're at production lock for The Last Orchard presentation, so I'd like to convene our standard roundtable. Before I approve the final plan, I need our rights and music leads to report any confirmed changes to the plan as it currently stands — the digital cinema package, two public screenings, audience photography, standard courtesy credit, 10-player ensemble, and 3:00 PM to 4:00 PM rehearsal at the Calder Cinema on October 18. Please let me know if anything has shifted since the draft was circulated.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to report a confirmed change on the rights side. I reviewed the revised license email from the Orchard Estate this morning, and it materially differs from our draft plan in several respects. The Estate permits exactly one public screening — not two. It requires 35mm projection, not a digital cinema package. It prohibits any audience or house recording, so audience photography is not allowed. And the required credit line is 'Courtesy of Orchard Estate,' not our standard courtesy credit. I have not yet uploaded the email to the shared production packet.
